descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name עָתְנִיאֵל, first judge of Israel, son of Kenaz and Caleb's younger brother (Judg 1:13, 3:9, 3:11; Josh 15:17; 1 Chr 4:13, 27:15). All occurrences refer to the same individual; the prepositional variant לְעָתְנִיאֵל (eng: of-Othniel, spa: para-Otoniel, swa: kwa-Othnieli) is a grammatical case marking, not a distinct sense. Transliterated uniformly across languages: hin: ओतनीएल, arb: عُثْنيئيلُ, kor: 옷니엘.
